phase: retrospective development diagnostics; predeclared before new derivation, not blind confirmation
question: Does current graph neighbor state warn of a headway deficit before the retained cut-in and late-ramp jerk failures, and how often does the same signal warn in controls?
trigger: Sam's continuation request and the 29 October handoff: the follow cap changed commands but not motion; later ramp encounters still fail comfort.
formula: margin = bumper_gap - (standstill_gap + headway * ego_speed + max(0, -relative_speed)^2 / (2 * closing_deceleration)); warning iff margin < 0. This kinematic screening margin is not a safe-gap proof or a jerk-feasible braking envelope.
information: Pure function of current ego speed and current graph neighbor front records. No event ID/class, future schedule, lane-change intent, future state, route destination label or observed future jerk enters the signal. Unknown adjacency stays unknown. Other-path proximity is not a longitudinal gap.
method: Verify immutable run inputs/outputs/source hashes. Stream each trace once to emit current-state warning records. In a separate scoring pass, align warnings to the native current leader switches and first samples of contiguous realized jerk exceedance episodes. Report target-specific prior warnings within 3 seconds, strictly before the switch/jerk frame; also report all warning exposure through H and drain. Preserve complete cohort, role/origin and external-wait ledgers.
acceptance: All six declared development runs retained; source/input integrity; current-only/prefix-invariant signals; unknown context not coded safe; exact replay of derived warnings. Report all results regardless of warning lead or nuisance exposure. No controller modification or comfort acceptance from shadow output.
transfer_review: Inspect hash-verified frozen original observation/action code and current graph/network. Establish semantic support before any actor execution; no padding/truncation, hidden lanes or new model load.
limits: One previously inspected synthetic development seed, provisional geometry, simulator-state inputs. Warning in a no-event case is exposure, not a labeled false positive. No new traffic rollout, causal intervention, learned transfer, training, empirical safety or team adoption. Strict actor numerical parity remains independently unresolved.
